about: Example rules for hooks/essence-check.py. Copy to ~/.claude/essence/checks.json and write your own. Keep the real file private: it says what your person cannot stand.

rules.why: The person ends the session, not the agent.
rules.break: \b(good ?night|sleep (well|tight)|sweet dreams|get some (rest|sleep)|(see|talk to) you (in the morning|tomorrow)|call(ing)? it a night)\b
rules.fine_if_person_said: \b(good ?night|g'?night|going to (bed|sleep)|bye|goodbye|later|talk (to you )?(tomorrow|later)|signing off|calling it( a night)?)\b
rules.reason: You signed off ({hit}) and the person did not say goodbye. The person ends the session. Say in one short line that the check caught you, and stay: answer what they said.

rules.why: The person reads the work. A recap of what just happened wastes their time.
rules.reason: You started a recap ({hit}). The person asked for no recaps. Give the result or the next step, and cut the recap.
